en.html:
Chief"Anything you need? I'll arrange whatever I can…"
Muramasa"I am all right."
Ichijou"I'm good too."
正宗《KWA-AA-KIKII! THE SOUL OF JUSTICE HAS BEEN FULLY EQUIPPED SINCE LONG AGO! WHAT OTHER EQUIPMENT IS REQUIRED?!》
黒瀬"My present arms are sufficient also. Not having time to gather my comrades is a regret…"
Chief"For infiltration, a larger party has its disadvantages too."
黒瀬"True."

署長 「何か必要なものはあるか？ 　可能な限り用意するが……」
村正 「私は、平気」
一条 「あたしもいい」
正宗 《クァァーーーキキィ！ 　正義の魂はとうの昔に完全装備！　ほかに 何が要るというのだァ!?》
黒瀬 「某も手持ちの武装で充分。 　仲間を呼び集める暇が無かったのは心残り だが……」
署長 「潜入という点を考えれば、それも一長一短 でしょう」
黒瀬 「うむ」

en.html:
We were going to Fudaraku Castle.

They, to fulfil their own purposes.
I—to see Kageaki and recover his will.

As he was now, he would probably reject me.
Even so…

ja.html:
これから、普陀楽城へ行く。

　彼らは彼らの目的を果たすために。
　私は――景明に会い、彼の意思を取り戻すために。

　おそらく、今の彼には拒まれるだろうけれど。
　それでも……。

en.html:
Chief"Your three objectives differ. But all three are what His Highness Prince Maidono desires."
Chief"His Highness said he is counting on you."
黒瀬"An honour beyond my deserving."
Ichijou"I'd do it without being asked."
正宗《JUSTICE IS NOT SOMETHING DONE ON ORDERS! AGREEMENT WITH IT, HOWEVER, IS ONLY NATURAL!》
Muramasa"…………"
Chief"Let me ask it too. …Muramasa."
Muramasa"Yes?"
Chief"My son. Please."
Muramasa"…………"
Muramasa"Yes…"
Ichijou"…………"
黒瀬"Time is precious. Come, we should be going."
Ichijou"Right."
